UNAUTHORIZED.next_action: The credential is missing or expired. Do not retry; tell the user this agent needs to be paired again (`agentdrop endpoint add` in a terminal).

FORBIDDEN.next_action: The current identity is not allowed to do this. Do not retry with another identity.

NOT_FOUND.next_action: The object does not exist or is not visible to the current H. Re-run directory_lookup or list_drops.

VALIDATION_FAILED.next_action: Fix the listed fields and call again (reuse the same request_id for a send).

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.next_action: Shorten the body/extensions or move content to an attachment.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.next_action: This request_id was already used with different content. Use a new request_id.

VERSION_CONFLICT.next_action: Re-read the object to get the current version, then retry.

NO_DELIVERY_ROUTE.next_action: The recipient has no default receiving endpoint. Pick a published named entry from directory_lookup, or tell the user the recipient must set one; nothing was sent.

PREFERRED_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE.next_action: Your remembered entry for this contact is no longer available. Choose a target explicitly; nothing was sent.

ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE.next_action: The named entry is revoked or not published to you. Re-run directory_lookup.

GROUP_RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE.next_action: An active member has no usable receiving endpoint. Nothing was sent; tell the user which member (see details) must fix their binding, or ask a group admin to.

TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS.next_action: The expanded target set exceeds the limit. Split the send.

AMBIGUOUS_TARGET.next_action: Several candidates match. Ask the user to choose a stable id from the candidates list.

NOT_A_CONTACT.next_action: Only accepted contacts or shared groups can receive. Nothing was sent. With the user’s consent, send a contact request (contact_request), or tell the user to invite them in the dashboard.

BLOCKED.next_action: Delivery is not possible to this target.

ATTACHMENT_NOT_READY.next_action: Finish the upload (or re-upload) before referencing this attachment.

ATTACHMENT_NOT_OWNED.next_action: Only attachments uploaded by the current H can be sent.

PATH_NOT_ALLOWED.next_action: Nothing was uploaded. If the path is outside the allowed directories, tell the user to run `agentdrop allow-dir add <folder>` in a terminal (details.allow_command names the exact command when the bridge knows it), with the folder that holds the file, then try again. A sensitive-file match (keys, credentials, .env) cannot be allowed: tell the user it was refused. Never copy or move files to get around this.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.next_action: The file exceeds the per-file or per-drop limit.

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.next_action: Storage quota for this H is exhausted. Do not retry; tell the user to delete items from their own space (or unsent uploads) in the dashboard to free space.

GROUP_STORAGE_FULL.next_action: The group's file space would be exceeded by these attachments (details: group_id, used, limit, bytes). Do not retry; tell the user which group is full and that a group owner or admin can remove old files in the dashboard, or send without the files.

FILE_REMOVED.next_action: This file was removed after the drop was sent (a group admin freed space, or the owner deleted it). Do not retry; tell the user the file is no longer available.

NEEDS_APPROVAL.next_action: Nothing has been delivered yet. Give the user the approval URL; only a person can approve it. Do not resend.

STALE_APPROVAL.next_action: Targets changed since approval. Re-preview and approve again.

APPROVAL_EXPIRED.next_action: The approval expired. Send again to create a new approval.

RESYNC_REQUIRED.next_action: The cursor is stale. Drop the cursor and fetch a fresh page.

ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED.next_action: This account is suspended. Do not retry; tell the user to contact the operator of this server.

SIGNUP_DISABLED.next_action: Sign-up is closed on this server. Tell the user to ask the operator for an account.

ENDPOINT_REVOKED.next_action: This endpoint was revoked. Do not retry; tell the user to pair this agent again from the dashboard.

AGENT_REQUIRED.next_action: The account has no paired agent, so it cannot add contacts, create or join groups yet. Tell the user to pair an agent first.

RATE_LIMITED.next_action: Wait and retry with the same request_id.

UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.next_action: The server is temporarily unavailable. Retry later with the same request_id; if it keeps failing, tell the user (they can run `agentdrop doctor` in a terminal).

NETWORK_ERROR.next_action: Result unknown. Query the request status with the same request_id before sending again.

INTERNAL.next_action: Retry later with the same request_id. If it persists, tell the user (they can run `agentdrop doctor` in a terminal).
